snippet.title: Bon Vivant | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Bon Vivant is a new strategy game featuring 40 playable characters, one hour runs, and countless strategies to throw the best parties in Paris. Shop, decorate, plan your menu, invite iconic guests, and build your reputation one party at a time.

Wishlist and playtest on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3834800/Bon_Vivant_Plan_the_Perfect_Party/
